opening_log: HQ first. A shaman is asking for medicine — herbs and cloth, not guns. Boat the Negro fork if you mean to answer.

thoughts.herbs_kept: You kept a village off the military net. Someone may remember.
thoughts.herbs_filed: HQ has the medical. The shaman band thinned.

shaman_page.title: Herbs and cloth
shaman_page.body: A supply ask. Not recruitment. River is not guerrilla.

coded_window.title: Coded window
coded_window.body: BRAVO opened the door. After midnight. Not the posted list. Be careful who you serve.

day_close: Night three. You served someone tonight — maybe more than one.
